project_type: Next.js 16 app with App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4
build_system: npm with Next.js build, mise for node version management
build_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
test_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit for type checking. 2. Run npm run lint for ESLint. 3. Run npm run build to verify Next.js build passes. 4. Run npm run test for unit tests.
setup_instructions: eval "$(mise activate bash)" to activate node version. Dependencies already installed.
environment_constraints: Must use eval "$(mise activate bash)" before any npm/node command. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: Never use useSyncExternalStore. Never call router.push() during render. createServerSupabaseClient() returns null - always check. Use CSS variables for colors. No hardcoded colors except theme constants (Navy #002B5C, Gold #C5A258, Green #00843D).
key_patterns: Pages use mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-8 wrapper. Page headers: h1 text-2xl font-bold + p mt-1 text-sm. Cards: rounded-xl border p-5 with style borderColor var(--card-border) background var(--card-bg). CSS variables defined in globals.css under .dark/.light classes. Feature components live in src/features/{name}/components/. Shared UI in src/shared/components/ui/.
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ - all protected route pages. src/features/{name}/components/ - feature UI components. src/shared/components/ui/ - shared UI components. src/shared/lib/ - utilities. src/app/globals.css - CSS variables for dark/light themes.
